name: service
title: Service briefing
subtitle: Internal working copy. Venue local arrival times.

sections.title: Upcoming service
sections.sql: select reference,venue,guest,arrival,finish,dining_table,covers,status,allergy_note,kitchen_ack_by from v_service where ends_at>now() and status in ('confirmed','seated','enquiry') order by starts_at

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by reason,reference

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule,record

sections.title: Covers by venue and channel
sections.sql: select * from v_covers where service_date>=current_date order by service_date,venue

sections.title: Guest history
sections.sql: select name,visits,no_shows,upcoming from v_guest_history order by name
